title: A DNA Typewriter records the cell lineage history of a mouse, from zygote to late organogenesis
summary: A lineage-anchored ontogeny of mammalian development, long out of reach, is coming into view.

title: Advancing mathematics research with AI-driven formal proof search
summary: We present the first demonstration of this method's value in solving open problems at scale.

title: The genetic basis for the production of toxic quinolizidine alkaloids in lupins

title: High-fidelity entangling gates and nonlocal circuits with neutral atoms

title: Oral deucrictibant for on-demand treatment of hereditary angioedema attacks: a phase 3, multicentre, randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled crossover trial
summary: Oral deucrictibant provided faster times to symptom relief than placebo and was generally well tolerated.

title: Lysine-specific demethylase 1 links metabolism to stemness in human neural stem cells
summary: Here, we show that lysine-specific demethylase 1 (LSD1) governs metabolic programs essential for stemness in human fetal neural stem cells.

title: Human spinal cord organoids recapitulate developmental and disease-associated oligodendrocyte lineage signatures
summary: Here, we establish human spinal cord organoids (hSpO) and cortico-motor assembloids as platforms to model oligodendrocyte development, neuron-glia interactions, and cytokine-induced dysfunction.

title: Characterization of structural variants in KOLF2.1J iPSCs and their potential impact on forebrain organoid differentiation
summary: Here, we identified 37 additional SVs using long-read sequencing and optical genome mapping.

title: Immunoregulatory gene GIMAP6 suppresses lethal atherosclerotic vasculopathy and ischemic heart failure
summary: Here, we report that loss of the immunoregulatory gene GTPase of immunity-associated protein 6 (Gimap6) in mice causes an inflammatory vasculopathy and accelerated atherosclerosis in the absence of hyperlipidemia.

title: Arabidopsis uses distinct coumarins and bacterial pathways for pH-adaptive iron acquisition
summary: We show that bacterium-mediated alleviation of Fe deficiency in Arabidopsis functions at varying environmental pH and is taxonomically widespread among root microbiota isolates from soils with different edaphic profiles.

title: STING reprogramming by estrogen promotes neutrophil extracellular trap formation and sex-biased resistance to ADC therapy
summary: These findings reveal an estrogen-driven resistance mechanism with broad implications for antibody-based cancer therapy.

title: A non-canonical function of glutathione to suppress ferroptosis via FSP1
summary: Together, our work clarifies a new mechanism of GSH-mediated ferroptosis suppression, thus highlighting the potential that targeting GSH metabolism should be beneficial for ferroptosis-related diseases whether or not it is related to GPX4.

title: A spatiotemporal lifecycle atlas decodes spatial coordination in rice
summary: Here, we combine high-resolution spatial transcriptomics, single-nucleus RNA sequencing, and a gap-free reference genome to build a 3D spatiotemporal atlas of rice, spanning 10 organs and 61 stages from seed to seed.

title: SPARCS enables scalable recovery of complex image-based phenotypes for genetic screening
summary: Here, we present spatially resolved CRISPR screening (SPARCS), a microscopy-based platform for forward genetic screening on single-cell images.

title: Cancer competition for vitamin B2 creates metabolic checkpoint for T cell ferroptosis
summary: Here, we establish the CareSLCs platform and identify that SLC52A3-mediated vitamin B2 (VB2) uptake is indispensable for T cell antitumor immunity.
